question.text: Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) differs from Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) by:

answer.text: Being short-term decisions taken more frequently than SAA to exploit market opportunities

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook distinguishes SAA as the long-term policy portfolio and TAA as short-term asset-allocation decisions taken more frequently than SAA to exploit market opportunities. The Trap: Calling TAA "longer-term" or "regulator-set" inverts the relationship between the two layers of allocation. Note: Per NISM-XXI-B workbook (p.174-175).
